title: Course Outline
summary: Stage 4 training covering massage techniques, massage types, Zura Massage standard, client challenges, professional boundaries, post-massage routine, hygiene, communication, and client satisfaction.

sections.title: About This Course
paragraphs: The Stage 4: Zura Wellness Professional Course advances the therapist's practical and professional competence across massage techniques, service types, Zura Massage delivery, client challenges, ethics, hygiene, communication, and client satisfaction.
Each module includes focused topics and a clear learning outcome so therapists know what they are expected to understand and demonstrate.

sections.title: Module 1: Massage Techniques
list: Friction: focused pressure on tight areas.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should understand different massage techniques and know how to apply them safely and effectively.

sections.title: Module 2: Types of Massage
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should understand the different massage options and when each one is suitable.

sections.title: Module 3: Zura Massage Standard
list: Balancing Swedish, deep tissue, and Zura techniques.
Service flow from start to finish.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should be able to deliver Zura Massage according to the Zura Spa standard.

sections.title: Module 4: Client Challenges, Blockers, and How to Handle Them
list: Clients who are tense or uncomfortable.
Clients who are rude or impatient.
Clients who request things outside spa standards.
Clients who are not satisfied after the session.
How to protect the brand while handling difficult situations.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should know how to manage client challenges calmly, respectfully, and professionally.

sections.title: Module 5: Professional Boundaries and Ethics
list: Avoiding gossip about clients or staff.
Knowing what is acceptable and not acceptable.
Protecting the therapist and the spa.
Upholding Zura Spa standards at all times.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should understand how to maintain safe, respectful, and professional boundaries with clients and colleagues.

sections.title: Module 6: Post-Massage Routine
list: Allowing the client to get up comfortably.
Changing towels and resetting the bed.
Preparing the room for the next client.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should be able to end every session properly and reset the room immediately.

sections.title: Module 7: Hygiene, Safety, and Cleanliness
list: Avoiding body odour and bad breath.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should understand that hygiene is not optional; it is part of client safety and professional service.

sections.title: Module 8: Communication and Reporting
list: Avoiding silence when there is a problem.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should know how to report issues early and communicate professionally.

sections.title: Module 9: Client Experience and Satisfaction
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should understand how every part of the service affects client satisfaction.
